c74object.name: bachmcp.algo.transform
c74object.digest: Transform a score with an algorithm
c74object.description: Runs a transformer algorithm (function transform(source, p)) on a score. Scores come in and go out as dict (bachjson); use bachmcp.translate to and from bach.roll. With source_mode 1 it holds the score it received and every output starts again from it. With source_mode 0 every run asks the roll for its score. It talks to the bachmcp.server open in any patch.

inlet.digest: dictionary, prompt, bang, param, load, open, name, source_mode, capture_source, write_to_playground, snap, bypass, repeat

outlet.digest: dump: asks for a score (connect to bach.roll)

objarg.name: name
objarg.description: The name the model and the server know this instance by. Unique across open patches.

method.name: prompt
method.description: Sends the text to this instance's conversation. The model, local or Claude, answers by writing the algorithm, which loads by itself.

method.name: bang
method.description: Runs the algorithm with the current parameters. Same as dump and run.

method.name: param
method.description: Sets a parameter of the algorithm, e.g. param shift 700. Pitch parameters also take note names. <name> <value> does the same.

method.name: load
method.description: Loads and runs a file. load_algo does the same, and try_load_algo is silent if the file cannot be loaded.

method.name: reload
method.description: Reads the algorithm file again. It also happens by itself when the file changes (see watch).

method.name: write_to_playground
method.description: Writes the last score sent to playground/scores/<name>.json.

method.name: bypass
method.description: 1: runs do nothing, and a score at the inlet goes straight out.

method.name: verbose
method.description: 1: says in the Max console what happens. Default 0: only errors.

method.name: watch
method.description: 1 (default): reloads the file when it changes on disk.

method.name: dictionary
method.description: A score as a dictionary. It becomes the source according to source_mode, and never runs the algorithm by itself, so there is no loop through a roll.

method.name: capture_source
method.description: Asks the roll for its score: the next score in becomes the source.

method.name: process_only_selection
method.description: 1: only the notes flagged in the slot selection_slot, which a selector writes. Default 0: the whole score.

method.name: selection_slot
method.description: The slot that flags the selected notes. Default 11.

attribute.name: auto_dump
attribute.description: 1: every parameter change runs the algorithm. 0: only bang does.

attribute.name: source_mode
attribute.description: 1: only the first run asks for a score, which is held as the source; every later run starts again from it. 0: every run asks for the score, so it works on what the roll holds now.

attribute.name: input_mode
attribute.description: 0: the whole score. 1: only the notes flagged in the slot named selected.
